statement: CorrVarAlloc has a PTAS: E[max_i X_i] >= OPT - eps in poly(n) time.

smoothness.note: Across Cholesky-factor l1 perturbations, |dE[max]|/(l1 factor distance) stays bounded by a constant (~0.09), consistent with the EMD-based smoothness (Lemma 2.4) that powers the correlated PTAS.

end2end.note: Correlated PTAS best E[max]=0.5681 >= OPT_est(0.5427)-eps(0.50); rounding diagonal variances to eps^3 grid costs drop=0.0024 <= eps.

mutation.note: A naive uncorrelated diagonal-only allocation (variance 1/n each) gives E[max]=0.5027, far below the correlated PTAS value 0.5681; the covariance (correlation) search in the PTAS is essential, not optional.
